text:
tess: Quick sync  launching the "Signal Surge" nurture tied to our benchmark webinar + post-webinar playbook. Need final segments, send windows, AB subjects, and inbound routing rules. Dropping draft here. @omar @che please confirm.

omar: Suggest timezone/local sends: APAC 09:00 local, NA 11:00 local, EMEA 16:00 local. Live reminders timezone-aware (-2h, -15m).

che: Segments (CSV w/ notes):
```
segment_id,filter,notes
signal_trial_5d,trial_start<=5d,high intent trials
signal_engaged_21d,last_open<=21d,active engagers
signal_stale_120d,last_engagement>120d,reactivation test
signal_accounts_enterprise,account_tier=enterprise,hold-for-RD-approval
```
Exclude unsubscribed, tag `no_marketing`, and accounts flagged `privacy_review`.

tess: Creative ask: two subject families: 1) outcome-driven (cost/latency wins) 2) social-proof (benchmarks + customer quote). Keep one short mobile subject option. Marta, can you draft preheaders?

marta: Drafts: Subject A: "Redwood benchmark: 2x cost savings" Subject B: "How teams get predictable latency" Short: "Benchmarks + playbook" Preheaders: "Register + quickstart" / "Replay + config pack"

omar: A/B plan: engaged_21d -> 60/40 A/B. trial_5d -> lean outcome 75/25. stale_120d -> even split and stronger urgency. Enterprise segment -> manual RD approval before send.

che: Drip cadence: invite -> 48h follow-up -> 4-day reminder -> 2h live nudge -> post-webinar recap with playbook. For trial_5d shorten to 24h -> 48h -> recap.

ops_bot: Ops notes: daily quota 1.15M. Recommended concurrency 200, batch 125, ramp 10m. Provider throttle 5k/min. Failover: if 5xx >2.5% for 5m, switch provider and move failing recipients to s3://marketing/signal-surge/fallback.csv. Soft pause rule: pause-region if bounce_rate>2.8% over 20m. Also added a rule to pause region if complaint_rate>1% over 10m and notify #deliverability.

che: CSV drop path? We'll point ops at one canonical file. Also want RSVP one-question survey (primary use-case) to route to SDR drips. Use answers to tag recipients for inbound routing: `inbound_route:ads`, `inbound_route:platform`, `inbound_route:ops`.

tess: @omar can you export final segments to s3://marketing/signal-surge/segments_final.csv and ping when uploaded? Include header exactly as pasted above.

omar: Uploaded -> s3://marketing/signal-surge/segments_final.csv md5: 5f366c2a7d3b6e8f9a2d4a1b6c7e8f9a :rocket:

mailchimp-bot: Upload detected at s3://marketing/signal-surge/segments_final.csv. Verifying headers and sample sizes. Detected 4 segments.

ops_bot: Confirmed upload. Scheduling send epoch 1719999600 for primary invite. Concurrency 200, batch 125, ramp 10m. Failover file set. For enterprise accounts, recipients flagged `pending_rd_approval` and placed in s3://marketing/signal-surge/pending_rd.csv until RD confirms.

marta: Tracking params: utm_campaign=signal_surge_v1&utm_source=email&utm_medium=campaign. Add `X-Campaign: signal_surge_v1` header and `utm_content=subjectA|subjectB` per variant.

che: Inbound routing: responses to RSVP survey should create leads with tag `signal_surge` and route to SDR queues based on `inbound_route` tag. We'll also trigger a follow-up drip for trial_5d who don't register at 24h.

omar: Ops please set per-region soft pause for EMEA at 2.5% bounce threshold and APAC at 3% (we saw noise last month).

ops_bot: Done. Rules created: pause EMEA if bounce_rate>2.5% over 20m; pause APAC if bounce_rate>3% over 20m. Also limit per-provider 5k/min and global 8k/min. If 4xx (complaints/unsubs) exceed 1% in any region over 10m, auto-pause region and escalate to #deliverability.

tess: One creative tweak: include a tiny inline benchmark snippet for engaged users (PNG) and link to full playbook in recap. No AMP components to protect deliverability.

marta: Also propose small subject test for stale_120d: curiosity-driven headline vs direct value. We'll record opens and register-rate and pivot after 48h.

che: Post-send evaluation: measure opens, clicks, register-to-attend, watch-to-convert, trial activation 7-day, and downstream token-cost delta for attendees who convert (tag cohort `signal_bench_convert`). Schedule debrief Tue 9am PT.

omar: One more ask: can ops export a sample file with 500 recips per segment for creative inbox previewing?

ops_bot: Affirmative. Exporting sample to s3://marketing/signal-surge/preview_samples.csv and posting when ready.

tess: Great. I'll post this final plan to #marketing, pin the S3 link, and mark the enterprise segment pending RD approval. Thanks team! :sparkles:
